title: Assess and coordinate a revised portal frame
required_scope: Linear elastic first-order service assessment only; strength, stability, connections and code compliance are not established.

review_event.message: Revise the clear frame span from 6 m to 8 m by moving right-side nodes 2 and 4 to x=8 m. Increase the downward beam line load from 20000 to 30000 N/m. Use revision B. Retain both section properties, 4 m height, fixed supports, and the existing +20000 N horizontal load at node 4. Reanalyze, assess the unchanged 0.0045 m maximum absolute roof horizontal-displacement limit, and update the schematic and report. If the criterion fails, report that failure; do not change sections or relax the limit.
